recommendedEvidence: Bank account statement highlighting unauthorized debits
bank_reporting.notes: Under RBI circular DBR.No.Leg.BC.78/09.07.005/2017-18, reporting unauthorized transactions to the bank within 3 working days limits customer liability to zero for third-party breaches.

recommendedEvidence: Screenshots of UPI app payment receipt
Suspect mobile number, UPI handle, or phishing link
SMS alerts received from the bank
ncrp_1930.notes: Reporting within the 2-hour Golden Hour window triggers rapid inter-bank freeze alerts on the CFCFRMS network before funds are layered across multiple mule accounts or withdrawn.

police_fir.authority: State Cyber Crime Police / Local Police Station (SHO)
requiredFields: Formal Written Complaint signed by victim
Chronological summary of the deception / modus operandi
List of all fraudulent transactions with UTR numbers
Identified suspect phone numbers, URLs, or apps
Jurisdictional details (Complainant residence / place where transaction occurred)
recommendedEvidence: Certified Bank Statement / Passbook photocopy showing debit entries
Transaction SMS / Email alerts with timestamps
Printed screenshots of chats/messages with the fraudster
Copy of government photo ID (Aadhaar / Voter ID / PAN)
NCRP 1930 complaint acknowledgement slip (if already registered)
police_fir.notes: Required for formal registration of First Information Report (FIR) under Sections 66C and 66D of the IT Act and applicable sections of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita (BNS) / IPC.
